description: Atlas Cheetah E, serial 826, displayed at the Sci-Bono Discovery Centre. 826 is confirmed by SAAF type documentation as one of the Mirage IIIEZ airframes converted to Cheetah E standard. Placement at Sci-Bono comes from aviationmuseum.eu's dedicated page for this airframe and independently from the saairforce.co.za places directory. DOUBT: neither source is recent and I found no dated photograph or visitor account from 2024-2026 confirming the aircraft is still on the site, so presence in 2026 is unverified.

REPLICA. Full-size replica of the Compton Paterson No.2 biplane, displayed alongside the Cheetah at Sci-Bono according to both aviationmuseum.eu and the saairforce.co.za directory. The original type was flown by Cecil Compton Paterson and used at South Africa's first flying school. Same doubt as the Cheetah applies: no recent confirmation of continued presence.
